title: Shopping assistant
intro: Ask where to find something this weekend, when a market opens, which pickup times a stall has, or how to use MarketLink. Answers come from MarketLink's own data and user guide.

canAnswer.title: What it can answer
canAnswer.product: Find a product across markets and stalls, with how many are left
canAnswer.price: A product's price, unit and stock
canAnswer.stalls: Which stalls are at a market on a given day
canAnswer.slots: A stall's pickup windows and free slots
canAnswer.guide: How to use the website: ordering, cutoff, cancelling, reviews, settings

how.title: How it works
how.text: An AI model (Claude) reads your question and picks from a fixed set of read-only lookups that run prepared queries on MarketLink's data; how-to answers come only from the user guide. It never writes to your account or orders. If the AI is unavailable, a keyword-based assistant answers instead.
